scope: RC19 pet appearance recovery, animation diagnostics and AppKit direction review

fixes.problem: An imported base atlas could only be displayed during dragging when its extra edge pack was absent. A normal selection left the idle character invisible.
fixes.change: Explicit basic_appearance setting renders the selected local atlas at every anchor with existing directional drag rows. Default false preserves saved appearance choice. No other character, artwork or source is supplied.

fixes.problem: An external copy of a supported character directory lost identity because selection depended on its exact .codex/pets path.
fixes.change: New import_package folder dialog reads registered identity, version and display name from that selected pet.json. Actual image bytes still use the existing decode/size/alpha validation. Existing single-image import stays available.

fixes.problem: Motion diagnostics counted invisible CSS changes and divided by the interval between changes, so a burst could hide a long stall.
fixes.change: Skip unloaded sprite images, fully transparent ancestry, hidden elements and geometry outside the viewport. Changes are divided by the whole stage. Report sampling_method=visible_element_styles, pixel_visibility_verified=false, and NO_ANIMATION_STAGES when none occurred.

fixes.problem: AppKit drag direction was based on the cumulative displacement from mouse down, so reversals before crossing the initial point retained the old direction.
fixes.change: Once dragging begins, each native event stores its screen position and resulting window origin for the next event. Positions and source-frame direction then follow the latest segment.

fixes.problem: Adding a new appearance field directly to pet-settings-v1.json makes RC18 strict deserialization reject all preferences on rollback.
fixes.change: Keep the prior settings file schema unchanged; persist basic_appearance in pet-appearance-v1.json. A real save/read regression parses the original file with the exact RC18 deny_unknown_fields schema and verifies the new mode reloads separately.

fixes.problem: Native diagnostics derived character identity only from the optional edge pack, producing null for a valid imported character in basic mode.
fixes.change: Both native diagnostic paths use the imported asset metadata for the existing character key, and add appearance_mode=basic or extended. Rendering readiness remains separately observable through edge.render.
